sensors.name: dep-cruiser
sensors.description: Architectural drift — detects import violations, circular dependencies, and layer misuse
sensors.guidance: Setup: copy `dependency-cruiser.json` to the app workspace root (e.g. `app/.dependency-cruiser.json`) and ensure the `dependency-cruiser` package is installed as a devDependency in the app workspace. Violations mean the builder introduced imports that break the intended layer boundaries. Run the `architect` skill alongside dep-cruiser output to fix structural violations before continuing.

sensors.name: eslint
sensors.description: Code quality debt — style issues, complexity, and error-prone patterns
sensors.guidance: Setup: copy `eslintrc.json` next to the app workspace's `package.json` (e.g. `app/.eslintrc.json`) and ensure the `eslint` package is installed as a devDependency in the app workspace. Lint errors signal accumulating code quality debt. Run the `clean-code` skill to address violations, or the `refactor` skill if the debt is structural.
